objective: Create a dependency-aware initial AR topology for AWG without opening work that violates the project authority boundaries.
assumptions: Coordinator remains authoritative for task lifecycle
AWQ remains authoritative for quality policy
oracle decisions are not implementation evidence
unknowns: The first executable formal checker implementation is not yet selected
transitions: planned -> open only when dependencies and specification gate are satisfied
open -> in_progress only through Coordinator claim
in_progress -> done only after implementation and verification evidence
invariants: No task has an unknown dependency
No active task has more than one owner
No conceptual task is promoted without a specification reference
AWG never substitutes oracle approval for quality or implementation evidence
acceptance_predicates: Coordinator doctor reports consistent structure and live state
Every initial conceptual AR references this bootstrap specification
Generated views contain no duplicate or cyclic dependency

formalization.checker: Agent Workflow Coordinator doctor plus AWG specification validator
